name: s1x_fwd_overflow_int12_n512
description: S1 F9 probe: every input and weight code +2047 (int12 x int12), N=512, B=1 outF=2, no bias: exact accumulator N*2047^2 vs INT32_MAX. Leg A predicts the first wrap at N=513; the doc says 511 is the last sound N. N=512 fits (512*2047^2 < INT32_MAX) but the static proof (512*2^22 >= 2^31) fails: the CHECKED path must return the exact result.
